blocks.html: After the recent eruption of the Taal Volcano in Batangas which affected thousands of Filipinos, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) RLove and Robinsons Malls’The Gift of Change program immediately embarked on its relief operations intended for the families affected and displaced by the Taal eruption. Relief packs which contained hygiene kits, canned goods, water and other basic needs were immediately sent to evacuation centers in Lipa City and Tagaytay City and were distributed by Robinsons Malls and Robinsons Hotels and Resorts employees.
